job.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Serving Platform
job.location: San Francisco, CA · Sunnyvale, CA · Seattle, WA
job.pay_full: $167,800 – $246,800 a year national US base pay range (base salary is localized to work location), plus opportunities for equity grants

details.about: DoorDash's ML Serving Platform delivers tens of millions of predictions per second across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo, powering search, recommendations, advertising and logistics. The team builds request routing, online feature retrieval and CPU/GPU inference so ML and product teams can deploy and run models on their own. This hands-on senior role leads core serving investments; the first 6–12 months focus on getting new ranking and recommendation models, including generative approaches, into online production and turning those solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
duties: Lead projects from customer problem through design, implementation and rollout; coordinate delivery, mentor peers and help shape the roadmap
Improve inference performance with production traces, load tests and CPU/GPU profiling, balancing model quality, tail latency, throughput and cost with model owners
Partner with the Compute team on capacity, placement and scaling
Build self-serve APIs and deployment workflows for models, runtime dependencies, features and versioned state, with validation, safe rollout and rollback
Evaluate, integrate and extend open-source tools and vendor capabilities for model serving, deciding when to build or adopt
Own production reliability through service objectives, observability, on-call and incident response, and automate away recurring operational work
needs: 6+ years of software engineering experience designing, building and operating production infrastructure or distributed systems
Hands-on experience serving large or complex neural models online, accountable for latency, availability and resource efficiency
Strong distributed systems fundamentals and a backend or systems language such as Python, Go, Java, Kotlin or C++
Understanding of inference trade-offs across batching, concurrency, caching, memory and CPU/GPU utilization, and the ability to diagnose production bottlenecks
Experience operating services on Kubernetes or comparable infrastructure, including resource configuration, autoscaling and failure recovery
Experience leading substantial projects through ambiguity, partnering with fast-moving ML or product teams and helping engineers grow
A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
nice: Integrating or extending inference tools such as Triton Inference Server or PyTorch
Multi-GPU inference, model parallelism, model-aware caching or accelerator scheduling
Building model workflows, deployment tooling or instrumentation with Metaflow, Helm or OpenTelemetry
details.benefits: National US base pay range $167,800 – $246,800 a year; base salary is localized to the work location and depends on skills, experience, qualifications and market conditions. Compensation also includes opportunities for equity grants. Benefits for regular employees include a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, a commuter benefits match, medical, dental and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance and a mental health program; salaried roles get flexible paid time off plus 80 hours of paid sick time a year.
notes: Locations: San Francisco, CA; Sunnyvale, CA; or Seattle, WA
DoorDash says experience with every listed technology is not required
